### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close #59572

Problem Summary:
In the log restore, the insertion of checkpoint data blocks kv-writes of log data, which slows down the log restore.
### What changed and how does it work?
Provide a storage target option for BR restore checkpoint data.

issue_context.title: Provide a storage target option for BR restore checkpoint data
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
The BR restore checkpoint data is currently stored in the downstream cluster. However, in the log restore, the insertion of checkpoint data blocks `kv-writes` of log data, which slows down the log restore.

Therefore, BR should provide a storage target option for BR restore checkpoint data.

review_comments: is it because session is not thread safe so we need two sessions one for writing and one for others?
Yes, one for checkpoint metadata operation, and another for checkpoint runner.
